environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the SQS consumer with IAM role 'consumer-role' that has broad DynamoDB permissions (dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem on resource arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/multi-tenant-data). SQS queue is shared across tenants with no message-level access control. The SHARED_AES_KEY environment variable contains a single AES-256 key used by all tenant producers. No DynamoDB condition keys are applied - the role can read/write any item in the table regardless of partition key prefix.

config.sqs_policy: open to all producers in VPC
config.encryption: single shared AES key, static IV
